info.title: virtu API
info.description: SimpleLogin-compatible email alias API. Authenticate with the `Authentication: <api_key>` header (SimpleLogin's exact header name — not Authorization). Errors use the {"error": "..."} envelope.

recommendation.description: Never returned yet (alias_used_on tracking not implemented)

post.description: Register a new account. The account starts unactivated: a 6-digit activation code (15-minute expiry) is emailed to the address; confirm it via POST /auth/activate before logging in.
Enter the emailed activation code to confirm the account. 400 on a wrong email/code, 410 once the code has been tried wrongly too many times (request a new one via /auth/reactivate).
Resend the activation code. Budgeted per account (3 emails/hour, the register email included): 429 when over budget — a deviation from SimpleLogin, which relies on its per-IP limit alone.
Authenticate and obtain an api_key for the Authentication header. MFA is not implemented: mfa_enabled is always false and mfa_key null. An unactivated account gets 422 (activate first).

get.description: Get the authenticated user's information. Also serves as api-key validation.

Get user aliases, paginated (20 per page). Filters pinned/disabled/enabled are presence-based and exclusive. The POST variant additionally accepts a JSON body with a `query` search string (some frameworks cannot send GET bodies).

post.description: Get user aliases, paginated (20 per page). Filters pinned/disabled/enabled are presence-based and exclusive. The POST variant additionally accepts a JSON body with a `query` search string (some frameworks cannot send GET bodies).

get.description: Get alias info (same shape as the /v2/aliases items).

put.description: Update alias fields. `disable_pgp` and `pinned` are accepted but ignored (PGP and pinning are not implemented yet). `mailbox_ids` keeps only the first id (single-mailbox aliases for now).

patch.description: Update alias fields. `disable_pgp` and `pinned` are accepted but ignored (PGP and pinning are not implemented yet). `mailbox_ids` keeps only the first id (single-mailbox aliases for now).

delete.description: Delete an alias. The address is tombstoned and never reusable.

post.description: Enable/disable an alias; returns the new status.

get.description: Get alias activities (email log entries), paginated (20 per page).
Options for creating a new alias: available (signed) suffixes, whether the user can create one, and a prefix suggestion derived from ?hostname=.

post.description: Create a new custom alias from a prefix and a signed suffix obtained from GET /v5/alias/options. ?hostname= is accepted but not recorded yet.
Create a new random alias. ?mode=uuid|word overrides the user's alias generator setting (default: word).

get.description: Get contacts (reverse aliases) for an alias, paginated (20 per page).

post.description: Create a contact for an alias; a reverse alias is minted for it. Accepts a bare address or a full mailbox ("First Last <first@example.com>"). Returns 201, or 200 with existed=true when the contact was already added.
Block/unblock forwarding from a contact; returns the new state.

get.description: Get the user's mailboxes, including unverified ones.

post.description: Create a new mailbox. It starts unverified: a 6-digit code (15-minute expiry) is emailed to the address; confirm it via POST /mailboxes/{mailbox_id}/verify.

Verify a mailbox with the emailed 6-digit code. Deviation from SimpleLogin (which verifies through a web link): the API accepts the code directly. Error strings follow mailbox_utils.py; 410 once the code has been tried wrongly too many times (re-create the mailbox to get a fresh code). Verifying an already-verified mailbox is a no-op that returns it.

put.description: Update a mailbox. Only `default` is supported; `email` change returns 400 (not implemented yet) and `cancel_email_change` is a no-op.

delete.description: Delete a mailbox. Its aliases are deleted (and tombstoned) unless transfer_aliases_to names another of your verified mailboxes (-1 = delete).

get.description: Aggregate counts: aliases, forwards, replies, blocks.
Get user settings (SimpleLogin-shaped; see PATCH for what persists).

patch.description: Update user settings. Only `notification` persists today; the other fields are validated (SimpleLogin error strings) but not yet stored.
Enter sudo mode by re-entering the account password. Sudo lasts 5 minutes on the presented api key and gates POST /api_key.

post.description: Create a new API key. Requires sudo mode (PATCH /sudo first); responds 440 {"error": "Need sudo"} otherwise.

get.description: Log out: revokes the presented API key (deviation — SimpleLogin only clears its web-session cookie; we have no cookie sessions).
Current billing standing: plan, Stripe subscription status (verbatim), and whether billing is configured on this server at all.

post.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for the premium subscription. Redirect the browser to the returned url. 503 when billing is not configured.
Create a Stripe Customer Portal session (manage/cancel the subscription). Requires an existing Stripe customer, i.e. a past checkout. 503 when billing is not configured.
